info.title: EconQuest API
info.description: Addresses an outside system can call over HTTP: the data API (series, panels and tables, docs/DATA_API.md) and the integration API (council output, webhooks and the event stream). Every country is named by ISO 3166 alpha-2 and alpha-3; either code is accepted wherever an address names a country. Values without a source read Missing with the reason; nothing is estimated.

servers.description: npm run dev on this computer (Docker: http://localhost:3737)

SmcrApiKey.name: X-SMCR-API-Key
SmcrApiKey.description: The integration key (SMCR_INTEGRATION_API_KEY), when key checks are switched on in Settings. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works. Never in the address.

ApiToken.description: A scoped API token made in Menu > Settings > API tokens, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> (or X-SMCR-API-Key). Each address names the scope it needs in x-scope. Scopes: read:data, read:council, read:events, write:holdings, write:exclusions, run:scenarios. The legacy integration key has the three read scopes.

Country.name: iso3
Country.description: Country as ISO 3166 alpha-3 (BRA) or alpha-2 (BR), any case. Kosovo: XK or UVK.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Your trace ID for this call (1 to 128 letters, digits and . _ : -). Sent back on the reply and written into every audit entry the call makes. Without one, the reply carries an ID the app made. A malformed one gets 400 BAD_CORRELATION_ID.

CountryCodes.description: Every country in an answer carries both codes.

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; null for WORLD or a region. Kosovo: XK (not an ISO code).

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 as the app uses it (Kosovo: UVK).

SecurityIds.description: Optional identifiers on a position. ISIN, LEI and ticker are stored in capitals and CIK zero-padded to 10 digits; entityId is stored and given back exactly as sent.

cik.description: SEC company number, 1 to 10 digits; given back zero-padded.

ticker.description: Letters, digits and . - / :, up to 20, with an optional exchange code after a space.

entityId.description: Your own ID for the position or issuer, given back unchanged.

ConsoleEvent.description: One envelope for every event. Values come with their source, the date they refer to (as_of), the validation badge and whether the licence register lets them be passed on (shareable).

id.description: evt_..., increasing; use with after= or Last-Event-ID.

as_of.description: The period or date the value refers to.

evidence_url.description: Where to read the value behind the event (relative addresses are on this server).

shareable.description: From the data-licence register; false when the source's terms are restricted or unconfirmed.

idempotency_key.description: The same for the same happening; also sent as the Idempotency-Key header.

country.description: ISO alpha-3, or * for every watchlist country.

as_of.description: The period the value refers to.

projected_to.description: IMF projection years exist up to here; value is the latest outturn.

reason.description: Why it is Missing or held back.

type.description: HC_BOND, LC_BOND, CDS, FX or OTHER (or the CSV words such as hc_bond, local, cds, forward).

notional_usd_mm.description: USD millions; a negative number means short.

entity_id.description: Your own id, returned exactly; positions are updated by it.

value.description: Country as ISO alpha-2 or alpha-3; identifiers checked as for positions.

HiddenList.description: Counts and kinds only: the list keeps fingerprints, never names.

hidden.description: Positions left out because they name a hidden country or security.

X-Correlation-Id.description: The ID you sent, or one the app made.

get.summary: Events after an id or a time (catch-up)

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Return events after this event id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Return events at or after this ISO time.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types; empty means every type.

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes; only events about these countries.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (default 200, highest 1000). With after or since, the oldest first, so paging with after misses nothing; without them, the latest.

200.description: Events, oldest first.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types; empty means every type.

parameters.name: countries
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes; only events about these countries.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: On reconnect: events after this id are sent first.

200.description: text/event-stream. Each frame has id, event (the type) and data (a ConsoleEvent).

post.summary: Add a webhook; the signing secret is shown once

201.description: The webhook and its secret (whsec_...). Each delivery is a POST of one ConsoleEvent with X-EconQuest-Signature-256 = sha256=HMAC-SHA256(secret, X-EconQuest-Timestamp + '.' + body). Failed deliveries are retried after 30 s, 2 min, 10 min, 1 h and 6 h.

200.description: Removed.
